jyotirlingas.name: Kedarnath
jyotirlingas.backstory: High in the Himalayas, Kedarnath is associated with Shiva as the lord of Kedar. Tradition connects the temple with the Pandavas after the Mahabharata.

jyotirlingas.name: Nageshwar
jyotirlingas.backstory: Near Dwarka, Nageshwar is traditionally revered as Shiva in the form of the lord of serpents.

jyotirlingas.name: Somnath
jyotirlingas.backstory: On Gujarat's western coast, Somnath is traditionally considered the first of the twelve Jyotirlingas and is linked with the moon god, Soma.

jyotirlingas.name: Trimbakeshwar
jyotirlingas.backstory: Located near the source of the Godavari River, Trimbakeshwar is known for its distinctive three-faced linga tradition.

jyotirlingas.name: Bhimashankar
jyotirlingas.backstory: Set in the Sahyadri hills, Bhimashankar is associated in tradition with Shiva's victory over the demon Bhima.

jyotirlingas.name: Grishneshwar
jyotirlingas.backstory: Near the Ellora Caves, Grishneshwar is traditionally regarded as the twelfth Jyotirlinga and is also called Ghushmeshwar.

jyotirlingas.name: Mahakaleshwar
jyotirlingas.backstory: In Ujjain, Mahakaleshwar is revered as Shiva in his form as the lord of time. Its linga is traditionally described as self-manifested.

jyotirlingas.name: Omkareshwar
jyotirlingas.backstory: Omkareshwar stands on Mandhata island in the Narmada River, whose shape is traditionally associated with the sacred Om symbol.

jyotirlingas.name: Kashi Vishwanath
jyotirlingas.backstory: At Varanasi on the Ganges, Kashi Vishwanath is devoted to Shiva as Vishwanath, the lord of the universe, and is among India's most revered temples.

jyotirlingas.name: Vaidyanath
jyotirlingas.backstory: At Deoghar, Vaidyanath is traditionally worshipped as Shiva the divine healer. Its story is closely associated with Ravana's devotion.

jyotirlingas.name: Mallikarjuna
jyotirlingas.backstory: On Srisailam's Nallamala hills, Mallikarjuna is a major Shaivite pilgrimage site and is revered together with the goddess Bhramaramba.

jyotirlingas.name: Ramanathaswamy
jyotirlingas.backstory: At Rameswaram, Ramanathaswamy is linked by tradition with Rama's worship of Shiva before his journey to Lanka.
